final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM Customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts AS a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id) GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT customer_count, CAST(customer_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(customer_count) FROM state_counts) AS share FROM state_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.customer_count) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value
